candidate.definition_en: A person who owns something or has a particular quality.
candidate.explanation_ar: الشخص الذي يملك شيئاً (مثل مال أو عقار) أو يتصف بميزة أو موهبة معينة؛ مالك أو صاحب.

senses.definition_en: A person who owns something or has a particular quality.
senses.definition_ar: مالك أو صاحب شيء أو ميزة معينة.
examples: She is the proud possessor of a new home.
He was the possessor of a rare talent for music.
By law, the possessor of the land has certain rights.
